operating_point.platform: GitHub runner (4 vCPU), CPU; timings one thread
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: the arrays MIME ships: Navion_2 (3 coils), CardioMag and OctoMag (8); rows: the field's 3 (over 10 mT), the gradient's 5 (over 1 T/m), both, or the force on a moment of 0.1 to 1 mA m^2 (over its own per-ampere size); points uniform in the central half of each declared region; wanted values log-uniform from 0.1 to 4 times what the limit reaches; limits 5 to 50 A
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: Hypothesis: 150 examples a dtype (the swap test), 100 a dtype (the derivative); detection_rate.py: 30 fresh processes planted and 30 clean per control, each its own Hypothesis seed

gate_1_swap.claim: the exact allocation meets SciPy's BVLS (on rows scaled to order one) within camera spike R2's line in both dtypes, limits inactive and active, on the three arrays MIME ships; where the minimiser is not unique, its residual within the residual's line and its effort no more than BVLS's

prediction.why: both are the exact least squares of one active set; the law's arithmetic is QR on unit columns

gate_1_swap.metric: verdict(): the commands' largest miss over the line where unique, the residual and effort otherwise

control.plant: ALLOCATION_PLANT=limits: the law handed limits 1 % looser; every problem with a coil at its limit misses by 1 % of the limit, 1e9 (float64) to 1e3 (float32) times the line
control.resolution: the line itself: SLACK x eps x (2 kappa + kappa^2 r / (|A||x|)) of the limit; the plant is far above it

gate_1_swap.if_wrong: a clean failure: read its example (print_blob) and classify by CLAUDE.md's five causes before any tolerance
gate_1_swap.cannot_discriminate_if: no drawn problem holds a coil at its limit (the plant inert): about half do, so a run of 150 examples holds dozens

gate_2_derivative.claim: forward and reverse mode agree to rounding; in float64 forward mode equals central differences over a segment that holds one active set (the commands affine there, the difference exact to rounding); float32's forward mode meets float64's at the same problem within the line; at an active-set change the derivative jumps and stays finite

prediction.why: within an active set the solution is the selected set's linear solve, which the re-solve differentiates

gate_2_derivative.metric: derivative_problems(): forward vs reverse within SLACK eps |w||J||v|; the difference vs forward mode within the line over the step

control.plant: free_tangent (a wrong active set: the commands' derivative the unconstrained least squares'); stop_branch (the derivative of what the bound commands leave the free ones stopped)
control.expected_rate: 30/30 each, in the float64 and float32 tests together
control.resolution: a problem with a coil at a bound and one free (and, for stop_branch, a tangent in the limit): about half the draws

gate_2_derivative.if_wrong: a clean failure: classify; a plant missed: count its runs' draws with a bound coil first
gate_2_derivative.cannot_discriminate_if: every coil free in every draw (both plants inert)

gate_3_guards.claim: every domain guard of the law (the column scale's, and the free subsets' rank stand-ins in both forms) is reached with its condition false at allocation_cases.GUARD_POINTS, and replacing its fallback there (twice, half) changes no output and no derivative
gate_3_guards.case: tests/control/test_exact_allocation.py::test_every_guard_of_the_law_is_reached_false_and_its_fallback_reaches_no_output_or_derivative, and the switch harness's coverage over the same points

prediction.unit: guards of the law reached false
prediction.why: a zero column reaches the scale's guard and the least-squares form's; rows of rank one the least-norm form's

gate_3_guards.metric: fallback_problems() and the guard sites it reaches

control.plant: single_where: the stand-ins removed (domain_guard returns its first branch), so no guard is reached

gate_3_guards.if_wrong: a guard no point reaches: add a point; a fallback reaching an output: the guard does not guard

gate_4_float32_per_array.claim: float32 against float64, per array MIME ships, over the swap test's draws: the largest miss as a share of the limit, and whether a guard is declared
gate_4_float32_per_array.case: probe/float32.py: 3000 problems an array (the swap test's draws, each kind), the law in float32 against the law in float64 on the same float32-rounded problem, and both against BVLS

prediction.basis: measured-before for Navion_2 (spike: 1.1e-5 on force rows); a guess for the 8-coil arrays, whose 8 x 8 rows are worse conditioned
prediction.why: QR on unit columns loses kappa times eps32, not kappa squared

gate_4_float32_per_array.metric: max |u32 - u64| / limit over unique problems; the scaled rows' condition

control.resolution: float64's own line, 1e-14 of the limit

gate_4_float32_per_array.if_wrong: an array past 1e-4 of the limit: a float32 guard is declared for it (the law's rows in float64, as the provider's budget does for OctoMag's field)

gate_5_allocate_moves.claim: allocate()'s currents, re-based, against the base's (SciPy's BVLS on unweighted rows): the largest movement where the minimiser is unique, and where it passes the swap line, each such draw one where BVLS stopped short (its residual above the law's)
gate_5_allocate_moves.case: probe/allocate_moves.py: 1000 points an array, allocate()'s three requests (field, gradient, both) with wanted sizes 0.1 to 4 times the reach and 200 fields near 0.1 uT

prediction.beyond_the_line: only fields near 0.1 uT and below, each with BVLS's residual above the law's
prediction.basis: derived (BVLS's absolute 1e-10 KKT tolerance; rows in T/A about 1e-3)
prediction.why: elsewhere the two solve one active set's least squares

gate_5_allocate_moves.metric: max |i_new - i_old| over unique problems; the count past the line and whether each is a stop-short

control.plant: none: a measurement, its discriminating range the line

gate_5_allocate_moves.if_wrong: a draw past the line that is no stop-short: the law or the line is wrong there; investigate before the PR claims anything
